build_python_package: build the diarizers python package with setuptools setup and publish to pypi
run_deps_table_update: run the DepsTableUpdateCommand to regenerate the dependency_versions_table.py file
create_deps_list: create a list of resolved dependency strings using deps_list with given package names
review_setup_config: review the setup() configuration including install_requires, extras_require, and classifiers
test_package_install: test installing the diarizers package with optional extras like quality and dev
